openItems.name: The Aluminium Promise
openItems.body: Frame, tray and magnets ship as flat neutral and flat yellow fills. Photo-quality raster assets for frame, tray and magnets to be added in a later session. CSS imitation of metal (multi-stop gradients, radial highlights) is rejected. Finish review: 7 of 8 resolved, this is the open one. The raster assets will need an after-hours variant (or a dimming treatment) for the dark theme.

narrative.overview:
Every week starts at the board: what the numbers did, why, and who acts. The whole product is staged as a white dry-erase board in an aluminium frame, hung in a pale grey room. Findings are written on it in marker, printouts and cards are pinned to it with yellow magnets, and a marker tray runs along the bottom edge. The landing page (Persuade) shows one real weekly review on that board; the workspace (Operate) is the same board turned into a desk, with a frame-colored rail and composer around a ruled enamel feed.

Density is moderate and editorial on the landing page, practical in the workspace. The ruled lines on the enamel (one every 40px) are the board's own grid. Color is ink by default: four marker colors, each with one job, and nothing decorative. The one number that matters is written five times larger than everything else, in a marker hand, circled. Every figure carries a small source tag that says what was read and run, because the product's promise is that every number is computed.

The world has two lights. By day it is the white board in a pale grey room. After hours (dark theme) it is the same board with the lights down: graphite enamel, dark paper cards that sit slightly lighter than the board, brightened marker inks, the same yellow magnets, and no neon glow anywhere. The world refuses the category default: no dark gradient hero, no dashboard screenshot, no row of icon cards. Depth is physical and soft (paper lifted off enamel, a frame lifted off the wall), never glossy and never a hard offset block.
keyCharacteristics: White enamel board with faint blue ruled lines, inside a neutral aluminium-colored frame with a marker tray.
Four marker inks with strict jobs: ink for text, blue for actions, red for misses, green for hits.
Yellow magnet discs pin white paper cards and printouts to the board, often at a slight tilt.
Archivo variable grotesk for all copy, widened on headings; Permanent Marker only for the hero figure and handwritten annotations.
Soft, layered, offset-free shadows; no gradients except the ruled lines.
Signature motion: figures and notes write on in marker strokes; changing the sample week erases and rewrites the board.
Light and dark themes from one token set: the board in daylight and the same board after hours.

rules.name: The Four Inks Rule
rules.body: Red marks misses only, green marks hits only, blue marks actions only; everything else is written in ink. If a color would only decorate, it is ink.

rules.name: The Brightest Board Rule
rules.body: The board enamel is the brightest surface in the room. Cards are neutral white paper sitting on it and separate from it by shadow, not by tint. The wall around the board is darker (enamel-shade).

rules.name: The After Hours Rule
rules.body: The dark-mode form of the Brightest Board Rule. In the dark, elevation reads as lighter: the wall is darkest (enamel-shade), the board is graphite (enamel), and paper sits slightly lighter than the board (paper), still separated by a deeper shadow. Marker inks brighten to stay legible; the magnet stays the same yellow; nothing glows.

rules.name: The Magnet Is Not A Color Rule
rules.body: Yellow belongs to magnets: pins, the active toggle, selection. It never carries text meaning.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: Components read color from the tokens above, never from literal hex, so every surface exists in both themes. A new color is a new token with a light and a dark value.

rules.name: The Marker Is For Writing Rule
rules.body: The marker face is used only for the big hero figure and handwritten annotations. Never set numerals in lists, ranks or steps in the marker face: its "1" reads as ")". Ranked notes and flow numbers are Archivo 800.

rules.name: The Wide Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings and the wordmark use the wdth axis at 108 to 112%; source tags narrow to 90%. Width is the type's emphasis tool, not color.

rules.name: The Soft Offset Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has blur. Zero-blur hard offset shadows do not exist in this world.

rules.name: The Tilt Rule
rules.body: Pinned paper may tilt slightly (between -0.8deg and 1.2deg) to read as hand-placed; it straightens on hover and on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Aluminium Promise (open by decision)
rules.body: The direction promises a brushed aluminium frame and tray and real magnets. The build currently ships a flat solid neutral frame and tray (alu, alu-lo) and flat yellow magnet discs, because no image generation was available. The user chose to keep the aluminium promise: photo-quality raster assets for the frame, the tray and the magnets will be added in a later session, each with its provenance recorded. Until then the flat fills are placeholders, not the target. Imitating metal in CSS (multi-stop gradients, radial highlights, faux sheen) is explicitly rejected; the replacement is real raster material or nothing. This was the one item left open of eight in the finish review (7 of 8 resolved). The raster assets will need an after-hours variant (or a dimming treatment) for the dark theme.

dos: Do write everything in ink unless it is an action (blue), a miss (red) or a hit (green).
Do put a source tag under every figure and every answer, stating rows read and code run.
Do keep one oversized marker figure per board and rank the notes beside it most urgent first.
Do pin paper cards to the enamel with a yellow magnet and the Pinned Paper shadow.
Do keep the enamel the brightest surface by day, with cards as neutral white paper on it; after hours, keep paper slightly lighter than the board and the wall darkest.
Do read every color from a token and give every new token a light and a dark value.
Do put agent chart images on the white chart mat in both themes.
Do use Icons8 fluent-systems-regular PNGs as CSS masks and keep the "Icons by Icons8" credit visible.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by removing the write-on, erase and scribble animations.
donts: Don't use red, green or blue for decoration, emphasis or branding.
Don't set numerals in lists, ranks or steps in Permanent Marker; its "1" reads as ")".
Don't put kickers or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use zero-blur hard offset shadows.
Don't use gradients anywhere except the board's ruled lines.
Don't imitate brushed metal in CSS with multi-stop gradients or radial highlights.
Don't add neon glows or colored shadows to the dark theme.
Don't use emoji or em dashes in UI copy.
Don't use a dark gradient hero, a dashboard screenshot, or a row of icon cards.
